generation_notes.90_degrees: Uses the four supplied right-facing walk frames.
generation_notes.270_degrees: Exact horizontal mirrors of the supplied right-facing walk frames.
generation_notes.other_directions: Uses the matching supplied 8-direction idle pose with subtle phase-based lower-body gait deformation and body bob; these are procedural approximations, not newly hand-drawn limb poses.
generation_notes.left_directions: 225°, 270°, and 315° are horizontally mirrored from their corresponding right-facing directions where applicable.
generation_notes.svg: Color-quantized vector path tracing of each PNG; fine painterly texture is simplified.
